stage_history.note: Gate data, statistics and thresholds fixed before any v2 quantity was computed. Candidate grid to be frozen from FIT-only design evidence (seed-1117 streams) before the formal gate (seed 1017) and before any v2 CAL job.

Definition and 9-candidate grid frozen from FIT-only design evidence (15 CPU jobs, 230 cross-fit configurations, seed-1117 streams). No CAL or DEV row of v2 exists. Gate data, statistics, thresholds and required levels unchanged from stage 1.

designed_after.report_as: failed adaptation; kept unchanged with its CAL and final results
designed_after.v1_cal: handoff/v10_method_pipeline_20261019/families/5/results/CAL/RuLSIF_exact (9 candidates; success<42 0-1/80; success<9 0/80; median 246-292 full-res px)
v1_cal_evidence_used: F_hat >= F_true in all 720 CAL rows (the search always finds a higher-energy wrong pose)
registration formula = brute-force N^2 V-mode J(g-1) to 7.8e-16; solve = stationary point of J(g-1) - lambda |theta|^2

kept_from_v1.ratio_model: RuLSIF, alpha = 1/2, unconstrained (no sign constraint), H = 1/2 H_P + 1/2 H_Q, float64 solve of (H + lambda D) theta = h_P with D = diag(0, 1, ..., 1) (change a)
kept_from_v1.reference_moments: exact within-scene V moments of the declared scene-V reference (U moments implemented, not used for BF)
kept_from_v1.readout: J(g - 1) = 2 E_P g - (E_P g^2 + E_Q g^2)/2 - 1, exact V moments over the registration positions
kept_from_v1.postprocessing: none: no clipping of theta, g or T
kept_from_v1.precision: float64 moment accumulation and solve; float32 features and registration (common precision record)
kept_from_v1.inputs: 9 x 9 patches from the host intensity path (robust-normalised BF luminance and SHG intensity), then v2's per-image empirical-CDF transform (change e)
kept_from_v1.centres: paired (cx, cy) centres drawn from aligned FIT patch pairs, equal count per FIT core, without replacement
kept_from_v1.bandwidth: FIT-only median rule over the preselected paired centres times a candidate multiplier, applied per modality (change c)
kept_from_v1.common_protocol: FIT32 / CAL8 / DEV32 through the V10 DataGuard; tuning seed 1017; final seeds 1001-1003; R6-REG-P2 search, support and perturbations; lexicographic CAL selection; DEV24 sensitivity; TEST134 and EPFL never read

changes_from_v1.definition: g = theta_0 + sum_l theta_l a_l(x) b_l(y); the constant is a paired centre whose two kernels are identically 1, so the exact V/U moments are unchanged; theta_0 is not under the ridge, so E_{(P+Q)/2}[g] = 1 exactly on FIT and the ridge shrinks the kernel part towards T = 0 (v1's (H + lambda I) shrinks g towards 0, i.e. T towards -1)
changes_from_v1.fit_evidence: Without a constant every variant has held-out J < 0 at the truth (v1 rule: mean -0.11 to -0.42, 0% positive; disk-only: -0.05 to -0.24; per-modality widths without constant: -0.09 to -0.38) and v1's rule is negative even in-sample (-0.07 to -0.26). Penalised vs unpenalised theta_0 is numerically indistinguishable at ridge <= 1e-2 (abc_c4 vs abc_c4_pen: |delta mean J| <= 0.0006, same fractions within 0.02); the unpenalised form is kept for the normalisation property

changes_from_v1.definition: FIT positions on the registration support: radius-129 disk about the image centre with Q.RigidEnergy's law and draw order; 4096 positions per FIT core (the number of positions of one registration energy); centres drawn from these positions
changes_from_v1.fit_evidence: Square support vs disk with (a)+(c), 4 centres/core: truth > imposed 0.29-0.65 vs 0.22-0.74 (x0.5: 0.52-0.65 vs 0.68-0.74), local test 0.11-0.38 vs 0.12-0.59; 4096 vs 2048 positions (32 centres, x0.25): truth > imposed 0.83/0.81 vs 0.81/0.77, local 0.75/0.75 vs 0.73/0.72 at ridge 1e-3/1e-2

changes_from_v1.definition: h_x = multiplier x median pairwise distance of the BF centres, h_y = multiplier x median pairwise distance of the SHG centres (each side's own FIT-only median rule)
changes_from_v1.fit_evidence: Scale diagnostic (job 1048602, disk): median BF patch distance 6.77, SHG 46.8, SHG share of the joint squared distance 0.87; under the joint rule the BF kernel is nearly flat (median value 0.965 at x0.5, 0.991 at x1). Joint width with constant: truth > imposed 0.23-0.48 (below chance); per-modality: 0.59-0.80

changes_from_v1.definition: Each whole image (each FIT image, the reference and each moving image as given) is replaced by its own mid-rank empirical CDF (ties averaged) before patch extraction
changes_from_v1.fit_evidence: Per-core marginal shift: the fold holding the SHG-bright cores trains with SHG median distance 29-34 vs 40-45 and is negative at the truth (-0.03); log1p SHG does not help (abcd_c16 x0.5 1e-4 = abc_c16 within 0.002). With the ECDF transform (16 centres): x0.25 ridge 1e-2 mean J -0.0011 -> +0.0011, J > 0 0.57 -> 0.72, truth > imposed 0.71 -> 0.76, local 0.53 -> 0.70, all four folds positive

changes_from_v1.definition: 32 paired centres per FIT core (1024 total; v1: 4 per core, 128)
changes_from_v1.fit_evidence: With (a)+(b)+(c)+(e) at x0.25 ridge 1e-3: 8/16/32 centres per core truth > imposed 0.79/0.79/0.83, local 0.73/0.74/0.75 (32 with 4096 positions)

functional_gate.purpose: FIT-only functional check that must PASS before any v2 CAL job; also reported for v1
functional_gate.data: FIT cores only through DataGuard role FIT; no CAL, DEV, TEST or EPFL image
functional_gate.sample: (FIT core, perturbation index i), i = 0..9: registration position rule seed R6-REG-P2|pos|core|i; BF luminance reference; aligned moving SHG intensity from the host moving-image pipeline at the zero perturbation; imposed perturbation Q.perturbations_p2(core)[i]

statistics.F_true: energy at the true alignment (identity pose)
statistics.F_imposed: energy with the moving image misaligned by the imposed perturbation (theta*, t*)
statistics.F_local: energies at +-6 deg and +-8 px (y, x) about the truth; diagnostic only

levels.deployed_position_heldout: the deployed fit (all 32 FIT cores, the CAL seed stream) evaluated on all 32 FIT cores at registration positions, which are independent of the solve's FIT positions
levels.crossfit4_core_heldout: 4 core folds sorted(FIT)[j::4]; for each fold the identical fitting procedure on the other 24 cores (same centres per core, positions per core, median rule, candidate multiplier and ridge), evaluated on the 8 held-out cores

functional_gate.pass_rule: A level passes iff mean F_true > 0, F_true > 0 for >= 75% of samples, and F_true > F_imposed for >= 75% of samples. The gate passes iff every pre-registered candidate passes both levels at the tuning seed 1017. Any failure blocks every v2 CAL job; no candidate is dropped or added after the gate.
functional_gate.v1_reported_with_same_gate: v1's nine candidates at seed 1017 with v1's own fitting rule (no constant, square support, 4 centres per core)

design_evidence_plan.data: FIT only, 4-fold core cross-fit, seed-1117 streams (distinct from the gate/CAL seed 1017)
design_evidence_plan.variants: v1 rule; (a) only; (b) only; (a)+(b) with 4, 8 and 16 centres per FIT core
design_evidence_plan.hyperparameters: bandwidth multiplier {0.5, 1, 2} x ridge {1e-4, 1e-3, 1e-2}; extensions only if the evidence is at a grid edge
design_evidence_plan.use: justify (a), (b) and any further change, and fix the candidate grid; never DEV

budget.cal_cap: at most 9 candidates and 8 L40S allocated GPU-hours, whichever comes first (runner-enforced, with 30 s accounting margin)

v2_expected_cost.registration_seconds_estimate: about 10-11 s on L40S (v1 8.1 s; extra 1025 x 1025 quadratic per candidate pose); the GPU gate measures it
v2_expected_cost.cap: CAL stops at 8 L40S allocated GPU-h (runner-enforced); finals are not under the CAL cap

reporting_rule: RuLSIF_exact (v1) stays in every table as a failed adaptation with its own CAL/DEV results. RuLSIF_exact_v2 is a new registered variant designed after v1's CAL failure, from FIT-only evidence and v1 CAL diagnostics; it is not a re-tuning of v1 and must be labelled as such.

tested_not_adopted.log1p_shg: host log1p SHG path: no gain over the intensity path (rounds 3-4)
tested_not_adopted.large_ridge: ridge >= 3e-2: discrimination falls (truth > imposed 0.23-0.75) and the dependence term at the truth turns negative at >= 0.1
tested_not_adopted.narrow_width_x0.125: J at the truth ~0 and truth > imposed 0.32-0.60
tested_not_adopted.joint_width_with_ecdf: abe_joint_c8 below abce_c8 on J > 0 fraction and local test

candidate_grid_rule: bandwidth multiplier {0.25, 0.35, 0.5} (FIT-supported range: x0.125 is uninformative, x1 and x2 discriminate less) x ridge {1e-4, 1e-3, 1e-2} (v1's ridge grid; >= 3e-2 worse); order multiplier ascending then ridge ascending (v1's convention); CAL rule picks among them

design_evidence.expected_gate_outcome: Across every FIT-supported configuration the cross-fit fraction of held-out samples with J > 0 at the truth is 0.57-0.72 (best: ECDF, 16 centres, x0.25, ridge 1e-2), below the pre-registered 0.75, while truth > imposed reaches 0.76-0.83. The formal gate is therefore expected to FAIL its crossfit4_core_heldout J-sign condition. The grid is chosen for registration discrimination; no threshold, level or rule is changed after seeing these numbers.
